format: one JSON object per line; complete evaluated set, not only errors

required.score: finite number in [0,1], using a declared upstream scorer
required.protocol_id: hash/identity of task/scoring/generation contract shared by matched arms
required.input_id: hash/identity of the exact question and image

optional.cluster_id: deidentified patient ID preferred for resampling

notes: No real example rows are fabricated.
Different method rows must agree on the original inputs for paired comparisons.
Generation/scoring changes require a new protocol identity.
Full raw branch logits are not needed for Stage 1 paired score analysis.
